title: Casper and the Cipher
author: Wren Blackwood
blurb: Sable Vasquez, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
